name: vsi-bench-debiased-eval
description: A benchmark for evaluating model robustness to dataset biases in visual-semantic tasks by providing a debiased evaluation split and curated examples. It is intended to measure whether models rely on spurious correlations rather than true visual-semantic reasoning and to compare models before/after debiasing interventions.
reputation: A niche research dataset used primarily by groups studying debiasing and robustness in vision–language models; limited broad adoption.
